decisions.reason: Because the aloe vera line closely builds on the firm's existing natural skincare know-how and integrated in-house capabilities, the firm can assimilate market feedback and improve the line, making a drop unlikely.

The hyaluronic acid serum is close to the firm's established skincare knowledge and integrated R&D, and the additional year of feedback has strengthened the firm's ability to interpret results and refine rather than drop.

The cleansing oil is close to the firm's existing natural skincare capabilities, though as a more recent launch the firm is still assimilating early feedback, so there is a modest chance of withdrawal while it evaluates improvements.
